title: Donald Trump says US is ‘going to run’ Venezuela after overnight strikes – live
summary: US president says ‘we’re going to run the country until a safe, proper and judicious transition’ can take place and that he is ‘prepared’ for a second attack Full report: US captures Maduro during ‘large scale’ attack Why has US attacked Caracas and captured Venezuela’s president? What we know so far about the attack Watch: Aircraft fly low over Caracas as explosions hit city The Reuters news agency says it has been told by a US official, speaking on the condition of anonymity, that the US carried out strikes inside Venezuela on Saturday . The unnamed official did not provide details. As mentioned earlier, the White House and Pentagon did not immediately respond to request for comment on Saturday morning. Continue reading...

title: Trump vows to 'rescue' Iran's protesters. Iran warns the U.S. to stay out of it
summary: President Trump warned Iran not to kill protesters. Iranian officials alleged the U.S. and Israel were stoking the sweeping protests, and said U.S. military bases in the region are legitimate targets.
